dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
There was an incident in my factory. One of my employees got stabbed by sharp tool.
{ARE YOU IN DANGER?}Are you in danger? Do you need police assistance?
Police!? No, no police! We just need an ambulance.
{ADDRESS?}What's the address you're calling from?
1st street 135
2nd avenue 246
Pine street 389
{WHAT HAPPENED?}What exactly happened to your employee?
He fell off a ladder and stabbed himself with knife while falling.
{I'LL SEND AMBULANCE AND POLICE} I understand. I'll send an ambulance and police to your location.
{I'LL SEND AN AMBULANCE} I understood. I will send an ambulance there.
Could you... not send the police??
I am sorry, what?!
I would be grateful if you didn't inform the police about it. I would be very, VERY grateful indeed.
{WHAT DO YOU MEAN} What do you mean by very grateful?
I mean $5 000 grateful...
{A BRIBE?} Are you offering me money for silence?
{NO WAY} Sir, I would like to inform bribery is a very serious crime.
{I WANT MORE} Five thousand? It's not enough... I want ten thousand.
{OK, NO POLICE} Ok, I won't send the police if you say that it's not necessary.
Listen, I have a family... wife... three children... and a factory that I really need to run.
. . . . . . . . . Okay, let's make it $7 000.
Ok, you can collect the money in my office.
{WAIT FOR PARAMEDICS} Please wait for the ambulance, sir.
{WHY?}Why are you asking me to do this?
All those health and safety regulations are expensive. We skipped some of them and the fine would ruin us.
{SOME OF THEM?}Some of them??
Whatever, just don't send the police okay?

reportElement.texten: A bribe was proposed to the operator and was immediately rejected.
There was an accident at a production site.
The operator committed a crime by accepting the bribe. Recording of the conversation will be send as a evidence to proper institution.
